note: Passages of the 13 November 2014 gazette: the gendarmerie and police appear as a public-service exception in the electronic-signature decree and in gendarmerie command appointments (one to a directorate of judicial intelligence and documentation, with nothing said of its records), a casier judiciaire only as a document in a certification-provider's application file, and procès-verbaux only as SME-law infringement reports; no police information system is named or described.
